title: CENTCOM: formation of 12 metallic orbs skimming the ocean

tellings.quote: >> Central command discusses cuboid formation of metallic orbs on USG networks.

plain: US Central Command, the military command that covers the Middle East, is said to have recorded a formation of 12 metallic balls flying in a box-shaped pattern low over the ocean. Michels reads this from a report called Immaculate Constellation, which a former Pentagon official named Matthew Brown has spoken about, and its line reads: "Central command discusses cuboid formation of metallic orbs on USG networks," meaning US government computer systems. If true, it would mean the military was quietly sharing reports of unknown objects among its own people.
